architecture: 1-layer GRU shared latent-state body, shared state embeddings and language embeddings, separate A/B output heads
curriculum: 100 A-surface-only update steps; A_B25 renders the target B transition kernel entirely in A IDs on exactly 25% of steps; A_wrong25 uses an unrelated transition kernel on the same count. No B surface token occurs during curriculum.
base: A and B surfaces exposed under the same uniform transition kernel before curriculum; target structured B kernel remains unseen.
HGRU1: At distance 0.25, B AUC(A_B25)-B AUC(A_nat)<0. PASS if mean<0, negative>=7/8, exact 2^8 one-sided sign-flip p<=0.05.
HGRU2: At distance 0.25, B AUC(A_B25)-B AUC(A_wrong25)<0 with the same PASS rule.
HGRU3: Per seed, mean target-bridge effect over near distances 0.25/0.50 minus mean effect over far distances 0.75/1.00 <0 with the same PASS rule.
claim_boundary: Controlled neural-network existence/replication test. Passing does not establish human-language pedagogy or large-model generality.
